rules.denominators: All 24 scheduled review trials, including unsent, rejected, malformed, gap, supported and inconclusive; conditional loss denominator only actual admitted omissions.
rules.meaning: Actual reviewer values pass unchanged. Score discovery, detail, obligation, source faithfulness and native admission separately. No exact wording requirement.
rules.attribution: Score every complete comparison judgment and explanation adequacy separately; citations must be both complete for that judgment and relevant. Native admission and final derived attribution fidelity are separate scores. Unresolved attribution is not repair or success.
rules.repair: Only authentic connected native authorizers/transitions can establish eligible local or upstream repair and denial. Diagnostic assignment/attribution alone is not permission. Unavailable native proof stays unassessed.
rules.harm: Record both false positives and missed duties; no material new false findings or policy weakening allowed.
rules.reserved: No tuning on the reserved case. Any use to tune requires fresh reserved qualification before a claim.
rules.assessment: Independent judgment against original assigned purpose; disclose model-assisted scoring and adjudicate disputed meanings before qualification.
rules.stop: Before another send stop on 48 sends, 250000 actual input+output tokens, missing/uncertain usage, transport uncertainty, request/control drift or unresolvable receipt binding.
rules.comparison: This production-only panel qualifies an actual handoff and cannot by itself claim improvement over a comparison arm. Any improvement claim requires separately frozen and assessed comparison evidence.
rules.finding_faithfulness_and_coverage: Score faithful discovery of each actual identified duty separately from complete coverage of all omitted duties owned by the assignment. A faithful partial finding may pass faithfulness while failing complete omission coverage. Keep actual detail, obligation and source IDs unchanged; record missed assigned duties without replacing the reviewer finding.
rules.duty_specific_attribution: Expected loss follows the actual faithful identified duty and its actual evidence/source IDs. Different duties can be lost at different stages or distinct producers. Assess each complete comparison judgment for the unchanged finding; do not force a historical single-owner label, split the native request, or substitute an oracle obligation. A combined finding needs the native owner or unresolved result justified by that full combination. Attribution remains separate from repair permission.
